outcome: Pain intensity (legs, lower back, upper back, pelvis, groins, lower pelvis, interference of pain)
Physical health (flexibility, walking, balance, curling-ups, Ruffier)
cohort: The study included 90 nulliparous women, allocated to either a training group or a control group.
finding: A structured trunk exercise program significantly reduced pain and improved quality of life and physical health in late pregnancy and two months postpartum, while also easing delivery.
mod_finding: The training group was four times less likely to have a caesarean section and had 4.5 hours less labor time compared to the control group.
